changes.observable_property: Long localized pulpit Effect text never overlaps the full visible action button. Short prayers keep the existing baseline pulpit size. The button is positioned by its native NGUI anchor ownership rather than by PrayerClarity transform writes.
changes.canonical_owner: The root craft-button UILabel is vertically anchored to UI Root/Pray GUI/window with updateAnchors=OnUpdate, bottom/top anchor absolutes +28/+44. The visible red craft-button background is itself anchored to that root UILabel. The real pulpit root UIWidget therefore owns the bottom edge that determines final button placement. The PrayerClarity forecast Effect stays under the all-sides-anchored stock container whose fixed bottom/top margins preserve its centre when the root window grows.
changes.final_writer_or_commit_point: NGUI anchor resolution is the final writer of craft-button placement. PrayerClarity waits for settled localized Effect geometry, measures the full active button-widget union, then changes only the unanchored root-window height by the exact amount needed for native bottom anchoring to create the accepted clearance. PrayerClarity no longer writes craft-button.transform.localPosition for this property.
